claude_proposed_widenings.name: PolymorphRevertTrigger: target_bonus_action
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The target can voluntarily end the transformation as a Bonus Action — a distinct revert trigger not covered by spell_ends or zero_hp. Currently only spell_ends, zero_hp, temp_hp_depleted, and dismissed_by_caster exist.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The transformation lasts for the duration or until the target ends it as a Bonus Action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: PolymorphActionRestriction: no_spells_only
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The target cannot cast spells but RETAINS its ability to communicate. The only existing variant, no_speech_no_spells, incorrectly suppresses communication. This encoding omits actionRestriction entirely to avoid a dishonest trace.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the target retains its... ability to communicate... and it can't cast spells.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: PolymorphFormSource: maxSize field
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Animal Shapes constrains the beast form to Large or smaller. PolymorphFormSource only supports creatureType and crBound; there is no size ceiling field.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each target shape-shifts into a Large or smaller Beast of your choice that has a Challenge Rating of 4 or lower.
